pages.text: Onyx Depths, Withered Forest, Ashen Wastes, Basalt Deltas, Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley. A 45x45 walled fortress. $(l)1.$() The gate is guarded by Withered Knights. $(l)2.$() Four towers hold Ash Wraith spawners on the ground floor and a chest upstairs (ladder).

$(l)3.$() The keep's great hall: Ember Stalker spawners and two more knights. $(l)4.$() The arena of the $(l)Onyx Sentinel$(). $(l)5.$() Behind the seals: three vault chests (enchanted Onyx gear, netherite, Soul Scythe, totem...).
